headline: Property Tax and Waste Fees: Local Tax Amnesty Begins; Online List of 1,500 Authorities That Have Joined
summary: About 1,500 Italian local authorities have decided to join the Rottamazione-quinquies, a simplified settlement procedure for tax collection notices. The amnesty covers items such as property tax and waste fees.
why: Tax amnesties let taxpayers settle outstanding debts at reduced cost, affecting local government revenue collection and public finances in Italy.
